Thought: Let me analyze each statement about methanol:

A. Can lead to blindness - Methanol (CH3OH) is known to be toxic when ingested and can cause blindness. When metabolized in the body, it forms formaldehyde and formic acid, which can damage the optic nerve and lead to blindness. This is a well-documented effect of methanol poisoning.

B. Causes vomiting for days - While methanol poisoning can cause vomiting, it typically doesn't specifically cause vomiting for days as a characteristic effect. This seems exaggerated.

C. Damages the central nervous system - Methanol poisoning can indeed damage the central nervous system. The metabolites of methanol can cause neurological damage.

D. Damages the lungs - While methanol can cause various health issues, specific damage to the lungs is not a primary or characteristic effect of methanol poisoning.

Based on my knowledge, statements A and C are true about methanol. Methanol poisoning can lead to blindness and can damage the central nervous system.
